name: Insulin aspart
halfLifeSource: FDA label for NOVOLOG (insulin aspart), Clinical Pharmacology 12.3 Pharmacokinetics — t½ ≈ 81 min
halfLifeNotes: Apparent half-life after subcutaneous dosing in healthy male volunteers; absorption-limited, so it reflects the injection depot rather than intrinsic clearance, and duration of glucose-lowering action is 3–5 h.
